remarks: Discover the possibilities in this spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom Fountain Valley home, situated on a generously sized lot with a flexible floor plan designed to accommodate a variety of lifestyles. The kitchen is a chef’s dream, offering an inviting space to cook, gather, and entertain. A standout feature is the upstairs bedroom suite, complete with a private bathroom, separate entrance, and kitchenette. This versatile space is ideal for extended family, long-term guests, multigenerational living, or anyone seeking added privacy and independence.
